messages:
Samira (CS): Quick FYI - ACME go-live tomorrow 10:00 PT. I9m scheduling a short priming run to reduce cold-starts for their streaming + batch mix. Posting the steps so CS, SRE, and eng can reproduce.

Jon (SRE): please paste exact commands/steps so oncall can follow if something trips.

Samira (CS): Short checklist: 
- confirm tenant flag `warm_pool` = true
- run priming for 30m (extend to 60m for renewal-risk tenants)
- pacing: small bursts (we used 2s between representative streaming calls)
- traffic mix: ~20 streaming example calls + ~50 small batch requests
- success criteria: `tokens_warmed` > 0, `kv_cache_fill_rate` >= 0.85, median_latency within SLO
- failure mode to watch: fallback to compact model variant (should not occur)

Samira (CS): Internal curl to start the warm job (dev-only admin endpoint):

```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/api/v1/admin/warm_pool" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","duration_seconds":1800,"burst_pacing_ms":2000,"cs_run_id":"cs-2024-05-12-42"}'
```

Samira (CS): Example minimal batch config we used for this tenant: 
```yaml
batch_window_ms: 25
max_batch_tokens: 4096
prefill_kv_cache: true
parallel_streams: 4
```

Priya (PM): Can telemetry emit `priming.started`, `priming.prefill.success`, `priming.completed` with `cs_run_id` and `tenant_id` tags? CS needs those events to tie to account health dashboards.

Samira (CS): Yes 100. We9ll add `cs_run_id` and a short `note` field to the job payload. Also adding a lightweight sample streaming request (PII-stripped) for the run: 

```json
{"user_id":"anon-427","prompt":"summarize short","max_tokens":64}
```

Jon (SRE): Oncall play if priming errors: 
1) check warm_pool logs in infra-ops (filter by `cs_run_id`)
2) if OOM/kernel errors: reduce `max_batch_tokens` or increase `burst_pacing_ms`, then retry
3) escalate: ping `@eng-oncall` and `@eng-runtime` with run id + last 5 log lines

Jon (SRE): Quick status check (dev-only):
```bash
curl -s "https://internal.redwood/api/v1/admin/warm_pool/status?tenant_id=acme" | jq .
```

Samira (CS): Notes for field reps running this manually: 
- do this in off-peak windows (aim for <20% of normal QPS during priming)
- add the `cs_run_id` + timestamp to the CRM account note
- capture one sample trace id and paste it into the account record for debugging

Priya (PM): For accounts flagged as renewal-risk, bump `duration_seconds` to 3600 and run a repeat 24h before the renewal call. If prefill succeeds, add a one-liner to the renewal playbook: "Primed: KV cache warmed, expect lower first-call latencies."

OptimusBot: scheduled_task: warm_pool job created tenant=acme run_id=cs-2024-05-12-42

Samira (CS): I9ll kick the priming run at 08:45 PT and report status here. Will post final metrics snapshot and one sample trace. Ping me if you want the run id earlier.

Jon (SRE): I9ll monitor `tokens_warmed`, `kv_cache_fill_rate`, `median_latency_p95` and have alerts on standby. If we see compact fallback, I9ll take immediate action.

Priya (PM): After completion, please add a row to the shared spreadsheet (tenant | cs_run_id | tokens_warmed | kv_cache_fill_rate | median_latency) and drop a 1-line customer-facing note we can reuse in renewals.

Samira (CS): Will post results and CSV-friendly row here when done.
